title: Cubic Time Dilation Model for Enhanced GNSS
description: "Cubic Time Dilation Model for Enhanced GNSS Accuracy and Security" (proposal, September 2024), together with Module VI ("Cubic time dilation") extracted standalone from the Chronowave Dynamics Temporal Engine compendium — the module that embodies the proposal's (1-β²)^(-1/3) exponent and its 1,000-simulation validation against the operational GNSS constellation.
